ai_overview.text:
You can submit a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request to the National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) online via FOIA.gov, by email to eFOIA@ntia.gov, by fax to (202) 501-8013, or by mail to the NTIA FOIA Officer. More details are available on the NTIA Freedom of Information Act Information page. 
National Telecommunications and Information Administration (.gov)
Submission Methods
Online: Submit through FOIA.gov.
Email: Send your request to eFOIA@ntia.gov.
Mail: Address it to:
FOIA Officer
National Telecommunications and Information Administration
U.S. Department of Commerce
14th Street and Constitution Avenue, N.W., Room 4713
Washington, DC 20230
Fax: Send to (202) 501-8013. 
Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) (.gov)
 +1
What to Include
State clearly that the request is made under the Freedom of Information Act.
Describe the records in detail, including subject matter, dates, and other identifying details.
Provide your mailing address (required even if submitting via email, fax, or FOIA.gov) and a daytime phone number.
Note your willingness to pay processing fees or request a fee waiver/limit if applicable.
If mailing a letter, mark the envelope "Freedom of Information Act Request". 
National Telecommunications and Information Administration (.gov)
 +2
Contact & Questions
For questions about an NTIA FOIA request, call (202) 482-1816. 
National Telecommunications and Information Administration (.gov)
If you share the topic or type of NTIA records you need and whether you are requesting for personal, media, research, or commercial use, I can help you draft the request or note fee considerations.

Submit a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request to the Northern Illinois Transportation Authority (NITA) by 
emailing FOIA@nita.illinois.gov
 or mailing a written request to 175 W. Jackson Boulevard, Suite 1550, Chicago, IL 60604, as detailed on the NITA FOIA page. 
How to Submit
Format: Make your request in writing under the Illinois Freedom of Information Act (5 ILCS 140). 
National Freedom of Information Coalition
 +1
Record description: Clearly describe the specific records or categories of records you want (rather than asking open-ended questions) and state your preferred delivery format (such as electronic/email or paper copies).

ai_overview.text:
Because "RTA" can refer to several transit authorities, how you submit a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) or public records request depends on the agency:
Regional Transit Authority of Southeast Michigan (RTA): Submit written requests to the FOIA Coordinator at 1001 Woodward Avenue, Suite 1400, or review guidelines on the RTA of Southeast Michigan website. 
RTA of Southeast Michigan
 +1
Regional Transportation Authority (Illinois): Check the Data Transparency Portal first or contact FOIA@nita.illinois.gov via the Regional Transportation Authority FOIA page. 
Northern Illinois Transit Authority (.gov)
Greater Cleveland Regional Transit Authority (GCRTA): Email publicrecords@gcrta.org, call 216-350-5131, or submit a request form through RideRTA. 
Tips for Your Request
Check public portals first: Many agencies post budgets, contracts, and reports online before you need to file a formal request.
Describe records clearly: Include specific dates, topics, or document types so staff can locate them faster.
Expect possible fees: Initial requests are typically free to file, though agencies may charge for copying, media, or postage.
